description: Four deliberate visible changes to the material pages and the method page, made when the pages moved to TypeScript (WP-24): (a) the way back to the selector links to its stable address (../) and no longer to the release-stamped file name (AR-19); (b) the method page labels the test answers as written by an agent and not yet reviewed by a person (OQ-11 A); (c) a value read from a twin's shared sheet is said to count once in the material's median, in the notes under the sheet table, in the hover of a value, on a product's card and on the method page (the reprint ruling, R-OQ09d); (d) a source whose address is a path on the owner's machine shows its title and "private reference" (R3 C). The list is every difference between the old build's pages and the new renderer's pages on the SAME database (the old one), so it holds these four changes and nothing else.
ruling: Owner ruling Q2-20 (redesigned pages and shared components are permitted; byte-identical HTML does not decide), with AR-19 (accepted), OQ-11 A (R-OQ11, 2026-10-20), R-OQ09d (the reprint ruling, OQ-09 A) and R3 C (2026-10-22)
